itemDisplayName: Deploy an additional Nodetype with standard load balancer to and existing Windows Service Fabric Cluster with existing Subnet configuration
description: This template allows you to deploy an additional node type to an existing Service Fabric Cluster running Windows Server 2022 Datacenter on a Standard_DS4_v2 Size VMSS. The cluster will be deployed into an existing virtual network and subnet. Bronze clusters are considered development clusters and should not be used in production.
summary: This template takes a minimum amount of parameters and deploys an additional node type to an existing Service Fabric Cluster.
